sourceChecks.finding: Official text non-thinking recommends sampling T=1, top_p=1, top_k=20, presence=2; original harness used deterministic structured generation. Add explicit official profile and compare with fixed seed, without assuming it helps vehicle commands.

Official example uses do_sample=False, temperature=0. Existing greedy choice is consistent. Native Phi3 loader supports checkpoint. Previous whitespace truncation already fixed with compact XGrammar and JSON validation.
tool_list and repetition_penalty=1.2 already matched. Add official stop_strings/endofturn and stop token handling.
enable_thinking=False is officially supported, so it was not ignored. Add official sampling profile T=.6, top_p=.95 for controlled comparison.

16kHz float mono native ndarray matches official format. Vendor automatically forces use_tts_template=True when ndarray audio is present, so our false argument was not the cause. Move task text before audio per official audio-understanding example. Fix app blanket relative-temperature guard: permit exact explicit seat/delta matches only.

Compared template tokenization against two-step current/fixed tokenization for Qwen0.8B, Phi, Gemma, HyperCLOVA. Extra tokens=0 for all four; token IDs match native template. Set add_special_tokens=False explicitly as documented, but do not attribute low scores to duplicate BOS.

Same 31 synthetic waves: Nemotron CER11.64%, exact17/31, median75ms; Whisper turbo CER2.09%, exact26/31, median88ms. Separate ASR benchmark isolates recognizer effect. Preserve originals and rerun full vehicle pipelines with Whisper+compact prompt+numeric notation normalization.

Pinned cached planners now local_files_only=True to avoid remote metadata delays during swaps. Qwen reference gated-delta/conv kernels remain; throughput numbers are this specific Transformers/L40S setup, not vendor optimized serving benchmarks.

notEquivalentToPublishedBenchmarks: Korean audio + custom vehicle schema + executor + TTS differs from text-only BFCL/IFEval scores, language distribution and thinking/sampling mode. This is a small application development/regression set. A separate 10-utterance new-number/paraphrase holdout is used for finalists.

generationProfileComparison.method: 10 text controls; exact same compact prompt and correct transcript; isolates sampling only. Not the 31-waveform demo score.
